// Compliant fixture — every read site is declared in the corresponding
// fixture manifest. Used by the synthetic-module test scaffolding.
//
// File extension is `.go.txt` so it is not compiled as part of `go test
// ./...`. The synthetic-module test scaffolding rewrites it to `.go`
// inside a temp directory before running the lint.
package settlement

type Payload struct {
	TaskID string
}

func ReadCompliant(p *Payload) string {
	a := p.TaskID // declared at line 14 in the fixture manifest
	return a
}
